response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer and software craftsman with a strong background in web technologies, microservices, and DLang. However, he lacks the specialized hardware and infrastructure background required for this Principal Performance Architect role, notably missing essential experience in SoC and IP modeling, GPU architecture, and deep learning workload optimization at the hardware level.
strengths: Extensive senior-level software engineering experience spanning over 15 years across various domains.
Proven ability to build high-performance, low-latency microservices using DLang and asynchronous I/O.
Strong track record of technical leadership, open-source contribution, and mentoring through workshops.
concerns: Complete absence of SoC and IP modeling or hardware-software co-design experience.
Lacks required expertise in analyzing and optimizing deep-learning workloads and GPU architectures.
Career focus has been heavily oriented towards full-stack web and app development rather than AI hardware accelerators.
